_comment: Raids beyond the map's edge (PLAN.md). An army from a village marches to the edge of the map on the side of a front (the nearest passable hex of that front on the map's last ring), then fights its way into the enemy's lands: `depth` (1 to maxDepth) field battles, then the siege of the front's stronghold, one every `stageHours` game hours (the first one stage after it reaches the edge). Each enemy force is of the front's troops (as a wave of index = the world's waves so far + stage), `enemy.baseUnits` x `enemy.growthPerStage`^(stage - 1) x `enemy.growthPerWave`^(waves so far), more for bigger groups like hordes; the stronghold's is `stronghold.sizeFactor` times that, fights from behind its walls (home bonus, defense x (1 + `stronghold.walls`)) in `stronghold.stance`. A field's terrain scales each side's attack and defense (`fields`, picked in a seeded order); field enemies fight in `fieldStance`. An army that wins a battle takes `loot.perKill` per enemy killed (x the front's personality lootFactor), plus `loot.stronghold` for sacking the stronghold, as far as it can carry: `carry.perSoldier` for each fighting unit and `carry.perWagon` for each military caravan. Raiding the North brings `north.resourceShare` of that, but each battle won has a chance at a rare find (`north.finds`, per battle; the stronghold's x `north.strongholdFactor`): hero gear for the hero (the leader's, or the owner's), a lore scroll the group hasn't found (for rare research) or a Svarog's Ember for the group. Every battle won makes the next horde of that front hate the more (`hatred.perBattle`; `hatred.stronghold` more for sacking the stronghold). A raid beaten in any battle (or left with no one) comes home with what it carries. The army eats its own grain all the way: it carries what its military reserve and wagons give it.
